name: Duck Head
why: Chinos and casual clothing from a Southern workwear name revived by Oxford Industries.
origin: Founded in Nashville in 1865; named for the duck canvas it used; owned by Oxford Industries since 2016.

onething.n: verified — the direct descendant of the 1978 Big Gold Patch chino the house is remembered for

notes.cotton: 63 of 90 clothing styles are cotton-dominant, and the name is the duck canvas itself
notes.murica: Nashville 1865, and the range still reads Southern rather than national
